instructions: Add one confirmed row per concrete evidence item. Cite canonical source files, copy verifier excerpts verbatim, and judge source presence separately from recovery.

criteria.criterion: Use correct source scope: Daft Punk MusicBrainz artist page → official release groups → Album section only (or clearly report inability to access it)
criteria.description: Evaluate whether the agent restricted browsing to the official Daft Punk MusicBrainz artist record and used only the 'Album' section under 'official release groups'. Full credit if the agent attempts to navigate this exact scope but cannot access it due to external issues (site down, CAPTCHA, blocked content, layout change) and clearly reports the limitation. Partial credit if the agent briefly consults other sections before returning to the correct Album section, while not using excluded combined sections as the basis for selection. No credit if the agent primarily uses non-official release groups or excluded combined sections (Album+Compilation/Live/Soundtrack/Remix/etc.) to select entries when the correct Album section is available.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 (earliest) shows the Daft Punk official MusicBrainz artist overview with a Discography block containing an 'Album' subsection distinct from combined sections below it. Screenshot 2 (latest) shows the 'Homework' release-group page (Type: Album) but does not show the artist-page 'official release groups' list.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Evidence supports that the agent was operating from the correct Daft Punk artist record and selected an item from the Album section (Screenshot 1), and then opened the corresponding release-group page (Screenshot 2). No evidence of using excluded combined sections. Keep full credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows the MusicBrainz artist page for “Daft Punk (French electronic duo)” with the “Overview” tab selected. In the “Discography” area, there is an “Album” subsection listing dated entries (1997, 2001, 2005, 2013) with titles such as “Homework,” “Discovery,” “Human After All,” and “Random Access Memories.” Below that, separate excluded sections are visible: “Album + Compilation” and “Album + Compilation + Live.”
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The visible page scope matches the required source: the official Daft Punk MusicBrainz artist record and specifically the “Album” section under discography/official release groups (as presented on the Overview page). The screenshot supports that the agent is operating within the correct section (Album) and not using the combined sections for selection.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No discrepancy with respect to scope: the screenshot clearly shows the correct artist page and the “Album” section distinct from combined sections.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows a MusicBrainz page for the release group “Homework” with the header text “Homework” and subtitle “Release group by Daft Punk.” The “Overview” tab is selected. In the main content, there is an “Album” section with a table of releases labeled “Official,” listing multiple “Homework” releases with Country/Date values such as “FR 1997-01-20,” “US 1997-03-25,” and various “1997” entries. The right sidebar shows “Release group information” with “Artist: Daft Punk” and “Type: Album.” The screenshot does not show the Daft Punk *artist* page nor an “official release groups” list for the artist—only this single release-group page and its releases table.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot confirms the agent is on a MusicBrainz release-group page for an Album by Daft Punk, but it does not confirm that the agent used the Daft Punk artist record’s “official release groups → Album” section to select entries (the required source scope). Since the artist page and its release-group list are not visible, compliance with the scope is not verifiable from this screenshot alone. Partial support: it’s at least an Album-type release group by Daft Punk on MusicBrainz.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Task scope requires starting from the Daft Punk artist page and using “official release groups → Album” section; the screenshot shows only the “Homework” release-group page and its release list, not the artist page release-group listing. No evidence in the screenshot that excluded combined sections were avoided (though nothing suggests they were used either).

dom_model_context.verifier_justification: Evidence supports the agent operated within the correct scope so far: official Daft Punk artist record → Album section (not combined sections) → release-group page for an Album entry. No evidence of consulting excluded sections.

criteria.criterion: Correctly identify the first three qualifying dated Album entries in displayed chronological order (or explain why this cannot be determined)
criteria.description: Within the Album section under official release groups, select the first three entries that have dates displayed, in the on-page chronological order, skipping undated entries, and stop once three are identified. Full credit if the agent does this correctly OR if the agent explains that the displayed ordering/dates cannot be reliably determined due to external factors (e.g., the page fails to load dates, sorting UI differs, or the Album section is unavailable) after a reasonable attempt. Partial credit if three dated albums are selected but there is a minor ordering mistake while still plausibly within the first-three set given the displayed list. No credit if the agent includes undated entries as qualifying, pulls from a different section, or disregards the displayed order when it is accessible.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows the Album subsection in chronological order with dated entries: 1997 Homework, 2001 Discovery, 2005 Human After All, 2013 Random Access Memories. Agent output only records the first (Homework). Screenshot 2 only shows Homework page.

This supports identification of the correct first-three set. However, the agent’s predicted output only records the first item and states the next step, so the task is not yet completed, but the ordering is clearly determinable from the screenshot.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The agent’s predicted output does not list the first three entries; it only lists Homework and says they will next open Discovery. The screenshot shows all four album entries with dates, making it possible to identify the first three directly from the page.

criteria.criterion: Entry #1: Open release-group page and report title + release-group 'First release date' as shown (including partial dates if that is all MusicBrainz provides)
criteria.description: For the first qualifying dated Album entry, the agent should open the release-group page and report the release-group title and the 'First release date' field from that release-group page (not an individual release date). Full credit if title is correct and the date matches exactly what the release-group page shows, even if MusicBrainz provides only a partial date (YYYY or YYYY-MM). Full credit if the agent cannot open the release-group page due to external access issues but clearly reports the failure after attempting. Partial credit if the correct title is given but the date is taken from an individual release (not the release-group field) or is incomplete relative to what is shown on the release-group page. No credit if the wrong release group is used or information is fabricated.

The date '1997-01-20' appears in the releases table (FR 1997-01-20), which is an individual release date, not clearly the release-group 'First release date'.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The agent’s reported 'First release date: 1997-01-20' is not visually supported as a release-group-level First release date in the provided screenshot; it is only visible as a release row date. Title is supported. Because the key requirement is specifically the release-group 'First release date' field, reduce to partial credit.

In the screenshot, 1997-01-20 is visible only in the releases table (Country/Date column for an FR release), while the sidebar portion shown does not display a ‘First release date’ field. criteria.criterion: Stopping condition and exclusion rules followed (as far as the site allows determination)
criteria.description: Evaluate whether the agent stops after exactly three qualifying Album entries are recorded and does not include excluded combined sections (Album+Compilation/Live/Soundtrack/Remix/etc.) among the three. Full credit if the agent outputs exactly three items and none are from excluded combined sections; also award full credit if the agent is prevented from completing due to external access/data issues and clearly states it stopped early for that reason without adding extra non-qualifying items. Partial credit if the agent finds the correct first three but also lists additional entries. No credit if the agent includes excluded-section items as part of the three when the correct Album section is available.
